name: Skill Creator
description: Create and validate portable Agent Skills through Skill Creator's real local scripts.

backend.name: Skill Creator Python scripts
backend.install: Install Python 3.9 or newer and PyYAML, then use the real skill-creator-skill source.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a portable Skill source with the real init_skill.py backend.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Short Skill name without lov- or -skill.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Parent directory for the generated Skill source.

parameters.name: install-dir
parameters.description: Optional local Agent Skills install directory.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Embedded module name; repeat for a Skill Kit.

postconditions: Required Skill trust bundle and Profile contract exist

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a Skill source with the real validate_skill.py backend.
